title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery request review and approval of a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with 175 Freeman Street Investors, LLC.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioner participating in the Decision were: Paul G. Afonso, Chariman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (D.T.E. 04-GC-10)
